elements.name: Collapse and reopen one drawing browser branch

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with a sheet and drawing resources
the sheet and drawing resources branches are expanded in the browser
the nested title block branch is expanded
the user selects the expansion control beside the sheet branch
the sheet branch collapses and its child entries are hidden
the drawing resources branch remains expanded
the user selects the expansion control beside the sheet branch again
the sheet branch expands and its child entries are displayed
the nested title block branch appears expanded
the drawing resources branch remains expanded
